tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List AI tool categories
tools.description: List all AI tool categories available on Aigregator (18 categories like Productivity, Image Generation, Developer Tools). Use this to discover what broad areas of AI tooling exist before drilling into specific tools. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.title: Search AI tools (free discovery)
tools.description: Search Aigregator's directory of 5,000+ AI tools by keyword, category, and filters. Returns only {slug, name} per result — this is a free existence check designed to feed the paid get_tool lookup. Use this to find candidate slugs, then call get_tool for full profiles (pricing, features, pros/cons, ratings). Free — no payment required.

query.description: Search keyword (e.g., 'video editor', 'chatbot', 'SQL from natural language')

has_free_plan.description: Filter for tools that offer a free plan

tools.name: get_tool
tools.title: Get full AI tool profile
tools.description: Get the full profile for a specific AI tool by slug. Returns name, description, pricing plans, features, pros/cons, ratings, alternatives, use cases, target audience, and more. Free — no payment or API key required. Use search_tools first to find slugs.

slug.description: The tool's URL slug, e.g., 'chatgpt', 'claude', 'midjourney', 'memo'. Slugs are lowercase with hyphens. Use search_tools to discover valid slugs for free.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.title: Compare 2-5 AI tools side-by-side
tools.description: Compare 2-5 AI tools side-by-side in a single request. Returns name, category, short description, pricing plans, features, pros/cons, alternatives, and stats for each tool — enough to make a recommendation without multiple get_tool calls. Free. Use search_tools first to discover candidate slugs.

slugs.description: Array of 2-5 tool slugs to compare, e.g., ['chatgpt', 'claude', 'gemini']. Use search_tools to discover valid slugs for free.

tools.name: recommend_tools
tools.title: Recommend AI tools for a need
tools.description: Describe what you need in natural language and get a ranked, explained shortlist of AI tools from Aigregator's advisor agent. Returns a summary plus recommendations (slug, name, why it fits, price, url, score). Answers in about two seconds. Prices and URLs come from the catalog and the 'why' is composed from typed judgments, not generated, so no field is invented. Free.

need.description: What you want to accomplish, in natural language. E.g. 'transcribe and summarize Zoom meetings', 'generate product photos for an e-commerce store'.

category.description: Optional category to constrain results (e.g. 'Productivity', 'Image Generation').

freePlan.description: Optional: only recommend tools that offer a free plan.

minRating.description: Optional: minimum average rating (0-5) a tool must have to be recommended.

annotations.title: Recommend AI tools for a need

prompts.name: find_ai_tool
prompts.title: Find an AI tool by use case
prompts.description: Guides the assistant through Aigregator's discovery funnel: search for candidate slugs, then pull full profiles of the most promising ones. All steps are free.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.description: What the user wants to accomplish, e.g. 'generate product photos', 'transcribe meetings', 'write SQL queries from natural language'

resources.name: server_info
resources.title: Aigregator server info & pricing
resources.description: Server metadata including pricing model, free vs paid tools, discovery flow, and links. Read this once to understand how to use the API.
